text:
maria: FYI reproducible hang in Go generator when cancelling a streaming request that hits the retry/backoff path (I have a tiny repro in sampleapp).

kevin: repro steps?

maria: 1) run `./sampleapp gen --stream` against local dev-runtime with 429 injection
2) let first token arrive
3) hit Ctrl-C -> process doesn't exit, goroutines leak.

jia: sounds like retry loop isn't selecting on ctx.Done(), so timer waits and keeps restart path alive while reader goroutines still hold body.

sam: can you paste logs + stack?

maria: logs:
```
2026-03-22T14:02:11.123Z INFO gen: started stream request
2026-03-22T14:02:11.456Z WARN http: 429 received, scheduling retry in 500ms
2026-03-22T14:02:12.000Z INFO gen: token chunk: "Hi"
2026-03-22T14:02:12.100Z INFO gen: user cancelled (ctx done)
2026-03-22T14:02:13.000Z INFO retry: backoff waiting (ctx ignored)
2026-03-22T14:02:15.000Z INFO gen: reader goroutine still active
```
stack:
```
created by github.com/redwood/inference/sdk/runtime.(*streamer).start
  /path/to/sdk/streamer.go:142 +0x45
```

kevin: confirmed. top-level sees cancel but retry middleware blocks.

jia: minimal fix: make retry middleware accept ctx and select on ctx.Done() during backoff, return cancel error; ensure response bodies/readers are closed so stream scanners exit. Also audit other places using time.After/time.Sleep.

sam: two asks: 1) does 5xx follow same path? 2) add a test in sampleapp asserting process exits within 500ms after cancel.

maria: 5xx goes same retry path, so yes. I'll add harness + unit that kills process and checks exit.

kevin: prefer minimal API change: pass ctx into retry helper and propagate sdk.ErrCancelled if canceled. Avoid global signal handling.

jia: also update stream read wrapper so Read returns EOF when ctx cancelled to unblock scanners.

maria: opening PR with changes: ctx-aware backoff, close bodies on early exit, sampleapp test, and a short docs blurb in Go SDK troubleshooting.

sam: assign to eng-runtime + devex reviewers. @oncall-bot set a 24h reminder to check CI flakes. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: reminder set — will ping #eng-runtime in 24h if CI still flakes.

kevin: happy to help with the test harness.

maria: thanks, will tag you on PR.

sam: TL;DR: generator streaming + retry backoff can block shutdown; fix is ctx-aware retry timers, close readers, add tests and docs.
